newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: NIGERIA'S ETETE IN VIENNA, SAYS FUEL CRISIS OVER.
newsitem.headline: NIGERIA'S ETETE IN VIENNA, SAYS FUEL CRISIS OVER.

text.p: Nigerian oil minister Dan Etete arrived in Vienna for the OPEC conference and said that his country's fuel crisis had been resolved, but did not elaborate.
"The problem is resolved and that is it," he told reporters.
A five-week fuel shortage in Africa's leading crude oil producer has caused chaos in the country, leaving hundreds of thousands of commuters stranded in Lagos, Nigeria's commercial centre, on Monday.
Etete expressed no preferences as to the outcome of this week's ministerial OPEC conference, scheduled to open some time on Wednesday afternoon local time.

The producer group's three-man quota compliance committee, of which Etete is a member, is scheduled to meet at 1300 GMT today. The other members comprise Iran's Gholamreza Aghazadeh and Indonesia's Ida Bagus Sudjana.
